chinese: 今天我们进行了一次去农场的学校旅行！
english: Today we went on a school trip to a farm!

chinese: 虽然很累，但非常有趣！早上，
english: It was tiring but great fun! In the morning,

chinese: 那里有大大的帐篷，种着西红柿、黄瓜，
english: There were large tents with tomatoes, cucumbers,
and many other fruits and vegetables.

chinese: 农民向我们介绍了这些水果蔬菜是如何从田间到我们餐桌的。
english: The farmer told us about how these fruits and vegetables go from the fields to our tables.

chinese: 因为我通常只在超市里见到它们。
english: because I usually only see them in the supermarket.

chinese: 然后我们直接开始干活了！
english: Then we got straight to work!

chinese: 首先，我们采摘了一些草莓。

english: but it took time to get it right.

chinese: 慢慢地，我们装满了许多篮子。
